name: Asheron's Castle
title: Asheron's Castle
summary: The home of Asheron on Asheron's Island, on top of a huge mountain with a long spiralling path; central to A Time of Chaos and today to the Quiddity Seed quests. In the kit: a 3 x 3 block of castle buildings on the summit plateau (z 374) - four-storey tapered towers, pitched-roof halls, a 31 m red-roofed spire tower (top z 405.5) and a 90 m minaret with a dome (top z 463.7) - around a small courtyard garden with an altar and benches; cliffs drop 300 m to the sea on the south and east. Kit landblocks west (0xD4xx) and north (0xD59B-0xD79B) of the castle are missing.

site.name: Asheron's Castle
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer asherons-castle (outdoor, north foot of the spire tower, 46 m from the centre). Kit landblocks west (0xD4xx) and north (0xD59B-0xD79B) of the castle are missing: every camera stays south/east of x 40900 / y 29760.

shots.standingOrder: Arc slowly round the mountain-top castle 150 m out and 48 m above its courtyard with the morning sun behind the lens; hold the minaret and towers centred, never drop below 20 m over the slopes.
shots.notes: Establishing: 0.05 turn clockwise 240 m out from the castle on its mountain top, 30 m above the courtyard (z 404; 184-337 m above the cliffs and slopes), from ESE to SE: the walled castle - towers, halls, the 31 m red spire tower and the 90 m minaret - crowning the huge mountain with Asheron's Island falling away below; morning sun (0.42) behind the lens. Kit landblocks west/north of the castle are missing; this orbit stays south-east. shots.standingOrder: Rise from the grassy east shoulder over the plateau rim until the castle towers and the minaret stand against the sky; stay 8 m above the rim grass.
shots.notes: Rising reveal over the east shoulder: starts 12 m above the grass slope 74 m east of the castle centre (looking up the slope at the plateau rim) and rises 34 m through the lane between two shoulder trees until the whole castle - east hall, towers, red spire and minaret - stands against the sky; subject out of the top of frame for the first ~3 s by design (edit window from 3.5 s). shots.standingOrder: Look straight up the north face of the 90 m minaret from 0.8 m above the grass, 6 m from its wall, with a slow 8 degree roll; nothing may come closer than 3 m.
shots.notes: Worm's-eye up the 90 m minaret from its north foot: lens 0.8 m above the plateau grass, 16 m from the axis (6 m off the wall), looking straight up the shaft to the dome with a slow 8 deg roll; the morning sun behind the minaret makes a backlit silhouette with sky glow. shots.standingOrder: Climb in a slow clockwise helix round the 90 m minaret from east to south-south-east, 50-64 m out, finishing level with its dome; keep 13 m above every tower roof.
shots.notes: Helix: climbs clockwise round the 90 m minaret from east to south-south-east (0.12 turn, radius 50 -> 62 m, height 45 -> 75 m above the plateau: z 419 -> 449, >= 13 m above every tower roof), the morning sun on its east face; ends level with the upper shaft and dome lantern.
